Get information on database connection options

Source: R/peekbankr.R
get_db_info.Rd

As of peekbankr 0.4, data are retrieved from the versioned peekbank dataset on Redivis (https://redivis.com/datapages/datasets/peekbank) rather than a MySQL server. Version information is discovered from the Redivis dataset itself: each Redivis version carries a `release_info` table naming the Peekbank release it holds.

Usage

get_db_info()

Value

List of database info: `current` (the Peekbank release that is the latest Redivis version) and `versions` (a named vector mapping Peekbank release names to Redivis dataset version tags)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_db_info()
} # }
